title: Check-ins
summary: Messages the coach starts on its own, at most once a day.
description: A proactive coach that sends a message for every rule that fires gets muted, so it speaks at most once a day and only when something wins.

requirements.text: Unasked, the coach starts at most `checkin.daily-budget` check-in a day across all the vault's devices; one asked for from Settings is exempt.

history.text: The coach starts at most `checkin.daily-budget` check-in a day, whatever fires.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the Settings button can send another one the same day.

requirements.text: Which trigger, if any, speaks is decided by plain comparisons over the digest; no model is called unless one wins.

history.text: Whether to send a check-in is decided by plain comparisons over the digest, without a model.
history.reason: Version 1 read as if nothing else gates a check-in; the spending cap (CHK-9) does too.

requirements.text: Every firing trigger that doesn't win is passed to the winning check-in as material.
Each trigger has a cooldown in days, and a trigger is not raised again until its cooldown has passed.

history.text: A condition trigger has a cooldown, so it raises one thing once rather than every day until fixed.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: a condition comes back after its cooldown if it still holds, and occasions have cooldowns too.

requirements.text: On Android an alarm evaluates check-ins daily at a user-set hour, `checkin.default-hour` unless changed, even with the app closed, while any trigger is enabled.

history.text: On Android the check-in is evaluated once a day at a user-set hour, defaulting to `checkin.default-hour`, even when the app is not running.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the alarm is cancelled when every trigger is off, and the app also evaluates on its own (CHK-10).

requirements.text: A check-in is saved as a new chat, never appended to the chat the user has open.
Tapping a check-in's notification opens that check-in's chat.
An unread check-in shows as unread on the Coach tab, also when its notification was dismissed.
Unasked check-ins stop for the day once that day's check-in model spend reaches the user's optional daily cap in USD.
On Android the app also evaluates check-ins on launch and on resume, at most every `checkin.app-interval`.

values.description: How many check-ins, not money; the spending cap is CHK-9.

history.reason: Only a whole hour can be set; a time of day suggested minutes too.
